idea-plugin.name: KMR Scripting
idea-plugin.description: Support for PascalScript used in Knights and Merchants Remake for scripting maps.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.1

  • Added: completion inside directives: "{$" offers every directive the game knows ({$I}, {$INCLUDE}, {$DEFINE}, {$UNDEF}, {$IFDEF}, {$IFNDEF}, {$ELSE}, {$ENDIF}, {$EVENT}, {$COMMAND} / {$CMD}, {$CUSTOM_TH_TROOP_COST}, {$CUSTOM_MARKET_GOLD_PRICE_X}) and closes it, "{$EVENT " the events of the game version, and "{$EVENT evtHouseBuilt:" the procedures of the unit - those with the event's signature first, leaving out the ones that already handle an event
  • Added: quick fix "Create procedure '...'" on an {$EVENT} directive naming a procedure the compilation unit does not declare; the procedure is created with the event's signature
  • Added: a procedure named by more than one {$EVENT}, or by an {$EVENT} for the event it is the default handler of, is reported - the game refuses to register the same handler twice
  • Added: known values. Conditions and assignments are followed through a routine (variables, record fields, constant-indexed elements): a nested "if A = False" inside "if A = True" is reported as always false, "if Ok" after "if not Ok then exit" as always true, "if Found" right after "Found := False" as always false, ranges too ("X < 3" inside "if X > 5"); hover or Ctrl+Q on a variable shows the value known at that point and where it comes from
  • Added: States queries are treated as stable within a tick (only Actions, or a script routine that might call Actions, change the game): a repeated "States.UnitOwner(U) = 3" is always true, and a repeated query with the same arguments is a weak warning with an "Extract to variable" fix
  • Added: refactorings Introduce Variable (Ctrl+Alt+V, with occurrences and in-place naming), Introduce Constant (Ctrl+Alt+C) and Extract Method (Ctrl+Alt+M: statements become a procedure with parameters, var parameters and moved locals; an expression becomes a function)
  • Changed: uses of deprecated API members are weak warnings (still struck out), so they no longer count as warnings
  • Added: quick fix "Replace with '...Ex'" on deprecated API calls where the migration is exact: integer ids given as numbers or named constants become the enum members the Ex variant takes (14 becomes utMilitia, [0, 2] becomes [gtMelee, gtRanged], -1 becomes utAny for the Closest functions), results compared with or switched on constants are converted the same way, legacy calls nested in each other are rewritten together; HouseAddBuildingProgress becomes HouseAddBuildingProgressEx(..., 1) and GiveHouseSite(..., False) becomes GiveHouseSiteEx(..., 0, 0)
  • Added: handlers of deprecated events (OnUnitAfterDied, OnHouseAfterDestroyed, OnHousePlanPlaced, OnHousePlanRemoved, OnMarketTrade) are reported on the procedure name or on the {$EVENT} directive, with a quick fix that renames the handler (or re-points the directive), types the id parameters as the enum and converts their uses in the body

0.2.0

  • Added: parameter name hints in calls (Actions.ShowMsg(aHand: 0, aText: 'Hi')); hidden when the argument is named like the parameter; configurable under Settings | Editor | Inlay Hints
  • Added: array elements addressed by a constant index have their own kind (Slots[SLOT_UNIT] vs Slots[SLOT_HOUSE]); @kind aId unitId|houseId declares a parameter accepting either; API members with an ...Ex variant are marked deprecated
  • Changed: API stubs use { } doc comments with @param for every parameter and @kind tags (the same tags you can write in your scripts); doc tags are coloured; block comments above declarations render in Reader Mode; default indentation is a tab (4 wide)
  • Fixed: type checks follow the game's PascalScript: "/" on two integers is an integer, enums and integers may be assigned to each other, Variant values (High, Low, Succ) are accepted anywhere
  • Added: folding of procedures/functions, var/const/type blocks, loops and with statements; breadcrumbs (procedure > for > if ...) above the editor; gutter icons also on {$EVENT} directives and shown without delay
  • Added: {$EVENT} directives naming an unknown event or a missing procedure are errors; rename refuses invalid identifiers and warns about names already used in the scope or by the API
  • Changed: game versions are r16020 and r6720; New | KMR Script offers an empty script or a script with include guard
  • Added: xor, shl and shr operators
  • Added: PascalScript's standard routines (Inc, Dec, Length, SetLength, High, Low, IntToStr, Copy, Pos, Trim, Round, ...) exactly as the game's compiler defines them: completion, parameter info, documentation and navigation; Delphi routines the game lacks (Random, Format, Min/Max, ...) are reported with the replacement to use
  • Added: kinds of integers (unit ID, house ID, group ID, hand index, X/Y coordinate, legacy type ids, ticks) known for the whole API and inferred for your variables, fields, parameters and results; a new inspection reports a house ID passed as a unit ID, swapped X/Y, arithmetic on ids, literals where an id is expected, comparisons between different kinds and conflicting assignments; completion, parameter info and documentation show "Integer (unit ID)"
  • Added: Reformat Code with a Code Style page (2-space Pascal indentation), structure view, code folding, gutter icons on event handlers, spell checking, live templates (proc, func, if, for, case, guard, msg, tick, ...), New | KMR Script, Go to Symbol
  • Added: type checking of assignments, arguments (e.g. an Integer passed where a TKMUnitType is expected), conditions, operators, indexing, for loops and case labels
  • Added: inspections for unresolved identifiers and API members (with "available in version X" hints), deprecated members, wrong argument counts, duplicate declarations across a script and its includes, unused locals, wrong event handler signatures (with fix), include/conditional directive problems, missing include guards (with fix), and invalid assignments/statements
  • Fixed: exceptions at IDE start while indexing
  • Added: code completion for API members (Actions./States./Utils.), variables, constants, types, routines, enum values and keywords; event handler templates (type "On..." at file level)
  • Added: parameter info (Ctrl+P) and quick documentation (Ctrl+Q) for API members and your own routines, with deprecation and "available since" information
  • Added: game version switcher in the status bar ("KMR: latest")
  • Added: the KaM Remake scripting API (Actions, States, Utils, Types, Events) as navigable stubs generated from the wiki; Ctrl+click on Actions.ShowMsg opens its declaration with documentation
  • Added: game version setting (r16020 / r6720) per project and per map under Settings | Languages & Frameworks | KMR PascalScript
  • Added: {$EVENT evtName:Handler} directives link to the event and to the handler procedure
  • Added: set of ... types and array of const
  • Added: go to declaration, find usages and rename for variables, constants, types, routines, parameters, record fields and enum values (case-insensitive)
  • Added: {$I} / {$INCLUDE} directives link to the included file
  • Added: analysis follows the game's model: entry-point scripts (next to .dat/.map) plus their includes form one unit; shared scripts show a banner to pick the entry point they are analysed in
  • Added: {$DEFINE}/{$IFDEF}/{$IFNDEF}/{$ELSE}/{$ENDIF} are evaluated like the game's preprocessor; excluded code is dimmed and its declarations are ignored
  • Added: matching of begin/case/record ... end, repeat ... until and {$IFDEF} ... {$ENDIF}
  • Added: error recovery inside procedure bodies; one syntax error no longer breaks the rest of the procedure
  • Added: operator precedence in expressions
  • Added: hexadecimal numbers ($FF), exponents, character literals (#13) and doubled quotes inside strings
  • Added: ranges in case labels, multiple statements in repeat/case else, multi-dimensional indexing, calls without argument list
  • Fixed: with ... do statements never parsed
  • Fixed: long procedures hit the parser recursion limit
  • Fixed: plugin can now be installed in all JetBrains IDEs, not only IntelliJ IDEA

0.1.2

  • Added: support for case-insensitive keywords

0.1.1a

  • Added: support for procedural types
  • Added: break/continue/true/false highlighting
  • Added: more highlighting configuration in settings

0.1.1

  • Added: support for (* comment *)
  • Changed supported versions

0.1.0

  • Added: support for commenting and uncommenting code
  • Added: matching begin/end pairs and brace pairs
  • Fixed: directives can now be anywhere in the code

0.0.1c

  • Added: support for with ... do statement
  • Added: support for empty statement body
  • Added: exit; support

0.0.1b

  • Added: support for enum construction
  • Added: support for repeat ... until loops
  • Added: in operator
  • Added: nil support

0.0.1a

  • Fixed: array-like expressions no longer require at least one value

0.0.1

  • Initial release
